record.reason: This primer describes approaches and methodological pitfalls for estimating software energy, comparing measurement/estimation methods and reporting practical experiment considerations. It offers no new LLM inference optimization or LLM-specific empirical result. It could inform evaluation of the linked green-inference work, but is a generic measurement guide rather than a technical lineage contribution.
record.title: Estimating the Energy Footprint of Software Systems: a Primer
